text:
nina: Quick note 94 QA reported mini-card rows feel cramped in collapsed sidebar. See mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/mini-card-cramped.png
otto: I reduced `--compact-gap` in last sprint to fit two more columns on smaller widths (8px -> 4px). helps density but maybe went too far.
priya: on touch devices the action icons are almost touching. hit-target guidance says 44px min. this is ~36px now.
ben: Accessibility: keyboard focus outline clips against the divider when cards are tight. high-contrast mode makes it worse.
nina: options: one, revert `--compact-gap` to 6px. two, keep visual gap but add invisible hit padding via pseudo-element. three, shrink card chrome (border/shadow) to reclaim space.
otto: pseudo-element hack worked elsewhere but breaks for overflow:hidden in the activity card. runtime fragility concern.
priya: shrink chrome is risky for visual hierarchy. I prefer revert to 6px and reduce `--card-vertical` by 2px to maintain column count. minimal token churn.
ben: also recommend `outline-offset: 2px` on `.card:focus` so the ring never touches divider. small and safe.
nina: agreed. plus add aria-label on action buttons: `aria-label="Open details for {title}"` so longer copy isn't needed visually. screen readers get context.
otto: one UX nit: success toasts linger 4s; when users batch-edit we get toast backlog. propose success 2.5s, error stays sticky, warning 4s. also cap visible toasts to 3.
priya: +1 cap to 3. prevents overlapping toast pile.
aria-bot: Reminder: update tokens/compact.md and components/toasts.md after landing changes. run axe quick-scan on staging.
nina: plan: otto will revert `--compact-gap` 4px -> 6px, reduce `--card-vertical` 14px -> 12px, add `outline-offset: 2px`, toast timing changes. target hotfix branch today, UX smoke tomorrow.
ben: assign me for accessibility review.
priya: thanks team. I'll file the PR description with screenshots and keyboard recordings. :sparkles:
